l4_steps.name: Capture flight departure event from PSS
l4_steps.input: Passenger name record (PNR) at flight departure
l4_steps.output: Accrual trigger event posted to loyalty processing queue
l4_steps.kpi: Accrual events captured within 24h of departure ≥99%
l4_steps.pain_point: Amadeus Altéa departure events can be delayed during irregular ops; cancelled-then-reprotected flights generate duplicate accrual triggers requiring deduplication logic not natively supported in Altéa

l4_steps.name: Validate member account active status
l4_steps.input: Accrual trigger event with member number
l4_steps.output: Account status flag: Active / Suspended / Pending
l4_steps.kpi: Zero false-positive account suspensions per month
l4_steps.pain_point: Accounts suspended for fraud screening block legitimate accruals; reactivation SLA is 5 business days — members with pending fraud reviews miss accruals with no automatic back-posting upon clearance

l4_steps.name: Verify ticket eligibility by fare basis code
l4_steps.input: Fare basis code extracted from PNR segment
l4_steps.output: Eligible / Ineligible flag with applicable earning rate
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of ineligible fare classes (award tickets, staff travel) correctly excluded
l4_steps.pain_point: ATPCO fare basis eligibility mappings require quarterly refresh; stale mappings incorrectly block accruals on newly introduced fare classes until the next scheduled update cycle

l4_steps.name: Retrieve flown distance and cabin class data
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa PSS / OAG Schedule Analyser
l4_steps.input: Validated PNR with operated flight segment
l4_steps.output: Flown distance in miles and cabin class code
l4_steps.kpi: Distance retrieval accuracy ≥99.9% vs. IATA great-circle distances
l4_steps.pain_point: Codeshare segments report operating-carrier distance rather than marketing-carrier distance; causes systematic under-accrual on partner-operated flights when the operating carrier's city pair distance is shorter than the ticketed routing

l4_steps.name: Calculate base miles using distance × fare multiplier
l4_steps.input: Flown distance, cabin class code, fare basis eligibility flag
l4_steps.kpi: Base miles calculation latency <3 seconds per transaction; calculation error rate <0.01%
l4_steps.pain_point: Multiplier tables must be synchronised between Comarch Loyalty and Amadeus Altéa; version mismatch after a programme rule change causes accrual discrepancies requiring a manual batch correction job affecting tens of thousands of accounts

l4_steps.name: Apply elite tier and promotional bonus multipliers
l4_steps.system: Comarch Loyalty Management / Salesforce Marketing Cloud
l4_steps.input: Base miles value, member tier level, active campaign codes
l4_steps.output: Adjusted miles award value with bonus breakdown by source
l4_steps.kpi: Promotional miles correctly applied in ≥99.5% of eligible transactions
l4_steps.pain_point: Stacked promotions (elite tier bonus + partner co-brand card bonus + targeted campaign) can exceed programme liability caps; no automated cap enforcement exists in the current Comarch configuration — over-issuance discovered only at month-end liability review

l4_steps.name: Post miles transaction to member account ledger
l4_steps.input: Adjusted miles award value with all multipliers applied
l4_steps.output: Miles balance updated; transaction ledger entry created with timestamp
l4_steps.kpi: Miles posted within 3 business days of flight departure (IATA Loyalty Standard); batch failure rate <0.1%
l4_steps.pain_point: Batch posting jobs can fail silently under high transaction volume during peak travel seasons; reconciliation lag of up to 72h before failures are detected means members contact the call centre before the system self-corrects, driving avoidable contact volume

l4_steps.name: Evaluate qualifying miles for tier re-qualification
l4_steps.input: Updated miles balance; qualifying miles year-to-date counter
l4_steps.output: Tier status decision: Maintain / Upgrade / Downgrade candidate
l4_steps.kpi: Tier re-qualification evaluated within 24h of miles posting; tier status error rate <0.05%
l4_steps.pain_point: Qualifying miles rollover logic at the programme year boundary is hard-coded in Comarch and requires a manual configuration change each January; incorrect rollover logic has historically caused erroneous tier downgrades affecting high-value members

l4_steps.name: Send accrual confirmation notification to member
l4_steps.input: Posted transaction record from Comarch Loyalty Management
l4_steps.output: Email or push notification with miles summary and updated balance
l4_steps.kpi: Notification delivery rate ≥97%; unsubscribe rate <0.5% per campaign
l4_steps.pain_point: Multiple accrual events on the same travel day (flight segment + lounge visit + partner hotel) trigger separate notifications; no deduplication or daily digest batching in the current Salesforce journey configuration — member over-notification drives opt-outs among frequent flyers

l4_steps.name: Ingest daily partner accrual activity file
l4_steps.input: Structured partner activity file from hotel, car rental, or co-brand credit card partner
l4_steps.output: Raw partner accrual records loaded to staging table in AWS Redshift
l4_steps.kpi: Partner file ingested and schema-validated within 4h of scheduled receipt; file rejection rate <2%
l4_steps.pain_point: Partner file format inconsistencies (non-standard delimiters, missing member IDs, variant date formats) cause up to 8% record rejection rate per cycle; no automated partner notification on rejection — manual follow-up adds 1–3 day processing delay

l4_steps.name: Match partner activity records to member accounts
l4_steps.input: Validated partner accrual records from staging table
l4_steps.output: Matched transaction records with confirmed member account links
l4_steps.kpi: Member account match rate ≥95% of valid partner records within 24h of ingestion
l4_steps.pain_point: Hotel and car rental partners submit member IDs in non-standard formats (e.g., with country prefix or leading zeros stripped); no automated fuzzy-match fallback in Comarch means unmatched records queue indefinitely rather than routing to a resolution workflow

l4_steps.name: Validate miles award against partner rate card
l4_steps.input: Matched transaction with partner ID and activity type code
l4_steps.output: Validated miles award value per partner agreement terms
l4_steps.kpi: Rate card accuracy ≥99% vs. signed partner agreement; rate discrepancy resolution within 5 business days
l4_steps.pain_point: Partner rate card amendments effective mid-cycle are not always communicated via API update; manual rate table maintenance in Comarch lags partner notification by 3–7 days, causing systematic under- or over-accrual until the next scheduled sync

l4_steps.name: Reconcile partner-posted miles vs. billing invoice
l4_steps.input: Monthly partner billing summary and posted miles ledger from Comarch
l4_steps.output: Reconciliation variance report; approved settlement invoice
l4_steps.kpi: Monthly partner reconciliation completed within 5 business days of period close; variance <0.5% of total billed miles
l4_steps.pain_point: Partner billing files use proprietary transaction IDs that differ from loyalty system reference numbers; cross-reference mapping is maintained in a manually updated Excel file — a single point of failure that causes reconciliation delays when the file owner is unavailable

l4_steps.name: Receive and triage missing miles claim from member
l4_steps.input: Member claim submission with supporting documentation (boarding pass, receipt, transaction reference)
l4_steps.output: Claim record created with investigation status and SLA timer started
l4_steps.kpi: Missing miles claim resolved within 21 days (IATA Resolution 9984 standard); first-contact resolution rate ≥60%
l4_steps.pain_point: Members frequently submit claims without required documentation (flight coupon number, original partner receipt); incomplete claims account for ~35% of total case volume and require a second contact cycle, inflating average handle time and breaching SLA on high-case-volume days

l4_steps.name: Post manual miles adjustment for approved claims
l4_steps.input: Approved claim record with validated miles value from investigation
l4_steps.output: Manual adjustment transaction posted to member account; claim closed in Salesforce Service Cloud
l4_steps.kpi: Manual adjustments audited within 48h of posting; adjustment error rate <0.5%; high-value adjustments (>10,000 miles) require dual approval
l4_steps.pain_point: Comarch manual override permits posting to suspended or fraud-flagged accounts without a blocking control; no secondary approval gate exists for high-value adjustments — creates an audit and fraud risk that is currently mitigated only by weekly spot-check reviews rather than systematic controls
